title: Graph neural downscaling of Indian monsoon rainfall
abstract: We propose a graph neural network that downscales Indian monsoon rainfall from coarse climate-model grids onto district-level watershed graphs. Nodes are catchments with orography and soil covariates; edges follow river connectivity. The claim is that a GNN outperforms CNN and linear statistical downscaling on extreme rainfall days while remaining calibrated for flood early warning in Maharashtra and Kerala.

title: Self-supervised ASR for low-resource Indian languages
abstract: We pretrain a wav2vec-style encoder on unlabeled telephone and community-radio speech in Marathi, Bhojpuri, and Kannada, then fine-tune with 20 hours of labeled data per language. The claim is that this matches or beats a 300-hour supervised Conformer on noisy conversational test sets and that a single multilingual encoder transfers to unseen Indic languages without a new tokenizer.

title: Federated learning for rural telemedicine triage
abstract: We study federated training of a symptom-and-vitals triage model across primary health centres in rural India without sharing raw patient records. The claim is that federated averaging plus simple differential privacy matches a centralized baseline on referral accuracy while surviving intermittent connectivity and non-IID clinic populations.
